Lift its front body in a single thick S-shaped serpent bend approximately one head-height above the water, head still leaning DOWN toward viewer and remains large foreground, TWO small natural eyes and blunt CLOSED-MOUTH snake-like head. Body is uniform thick serpent body narrowing only toward a long single tail, no distinct dinosaur neck, no limbs/flippers/fins/horns. Keep approximate 12-15 foot length and boat comparison, no giant scale. Make dark serpent head/body dominate, tense forward movement not cute. No text, aura, energy, people, injury or gore. name: Moon Lake Monster
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected after morphology correction: one dark limbless serpent-like body with low rounded bumpy-log scaled back, no dorsal triangular spikes, no limbs/flippers/horns. Broad reptilian head approaches directly, long body trails in clear V-shaped wake. Low close encounter makes creature dominant/dangerous at 200px, empty rowboat contextual not giant size. No magical power/text/glow/victims. Seven Sangar checks pass; first crocodilian/spiky attempt archived.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head, flank, back/tail and boat crops. One large dark serpent-like creature (moon-lake-monster-c04) with one blunt reptilian head, two small eyes, two nostrils and a closed mouth. The body is thick and limbless, with no legs, flippers, fins, horns or dorsal spikes. The back is covered in low, rounded, irregular scaled bumps like a 'bumpy log' (c06), which fixes the crocodile scutes of the self-rejected first attempt. The body trails back in an S-curve to a tapering tail. It swims straight at a water-level camera, pushing a clear V-shaped wake and spray (c04). The setting is a moonlit alpine lake with pines and snowy Uinta peaks (c01). An empty rowboat sits near the far shore, and in perspective the length stays in a plausible range, not a giant sea serpent. No victims, text or aura. The head-on approach at eye level, the dark wet mass and the wake make it a dangerous close encounter at 200px, not an ordinary animal.
